issues.issue: Result attributes difference -2.1 (95% CI -2.9,-1.3, Wk4) and -2.6 (-3.4,-1.7, Wk12) to VEOZAH 45 mg, but in the cited table these are the FIRST difference columns (the 30 mg arm); the 45 mg values are -2.6 (-3.5,-1.6) and -2.5 (-3.6,-1.5), so the dose column is mislabeled.

Trial 2 result cites the exact same table (line 180) as Trial 1 but pulls the second difference columns, meaning the two 'separate trials' are drawing the two dose columns from one single table; the per-trial results are not distinguished and at least one is mis-attributed.

Only VEOZAH-vs-placebo differences are given; the co-primary endpoint also includes severity (endpoint states frequency AND severity), so the result reports only the frequency component and omits severity results.

Citation text reads 'PDUFA date of February 22, 2022' which conflicts with the field text (2023) and the goal-date citation (February 22, 2023); likely OCR typo but the discrepancy is embedded in the quote.
Automated flag on number '45' (VEOZAH 45 mg) is a dose and is supported by the n citation; false positive.
Automated flags on '505' (statutory section 505(b)) and '12' (part of date May 12, 2023) are false positives that should be excluded.
